facts.value: Local road maintenance for streets within municipal boundaries.
Solid waste collection and disposal within municipal jurisdiction.
Street lighting on local roads, local parks, public spaces management.
Building permits, local drainage maintenance, minor local flooding (non-emergency blocked drains).
NOT responsible for national roads, highways, autostrads — those belong to MPWT. Boundary is local/residential street vs state road.
963 municipalities across Lebanon, organized by district and governed by Law 118/1977. Each municipality has defined geographical boundaries.
No national hotline. Each municipality has its own council and contact. Lookup via CedarFix GPS→district→municipality map.
No nationally mandated SLA. CedarFix operational targets: potholes 48-96h, waste 24-48h, drainage 24-48h.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-001 deadline_basis='CedarFix operational target, not legal SLA'. No legal SLA exists at national level for municipalities.

facts.value: CedarFix routes to municipality based on GPS coordinates → district lookup. Citizen may also visit municipal council in person. Some municipalities/platforms expose digital complaint/report workflows through official forms or apps such as Zahle, Abbassieh, Baladi Map, Baldati, Baladiat, Mwakaba, and local apps like Kab Elias; coverage is not universal and each workflow must be verified per municipality.
